correctness.rationale: PASS. Verified the exact three-dimensional recurrence as equation (1) in the 2020 source and the critical specialization µ=1. The positive open wedge conditions imply x+y+z<1/2, βx<1/2, γy<1/4 and z<x/2 invariant: each species decreases with y factor <=1/2, z factor <=1/4 and z/x factor <=1/2. For any conditionally forever-positive simplex orbit, t=1/x increases by ≥1 per iterate and y_n≤y0 β^n Γ(t0)/Γ(n+t0), hence p_n=y_n+z_n has finite polynomially weighted sums. Independently algebraically reconstructed t_{n+1}-t_n=1+1/t_n+[t_n(t_n-1)]^{-1}+t_n p_n/[(1-1/t_n-p_n)(1-1/t_n)]. Discrete product bounds t=O(n) and the summable correction yield t=n+log n+H+O(log n/n); expansion log(kx_k)=-(log k+H)/k+O(log²k/k²) gives a convergent log-y prefactor and squared-log term. Summing log z_{k+1}-log z_k=logγ+log y_k and Stirling yields universal -1/2 n²logn + (3/4+1/2logβ)n² and O(nlog²n), without γ in leading coefficients. Independent stable-log numerical orbit checks at n=500,2000,6000 for two parameter sets corroborate H stabilization and limiting second coefficient. No claim for non-positive/escaping orbits.
